title: Emotes / Eight-card vocabulary
slide_intent: Treat community symbols as a visual vocabulary because familiar reactions can carry meanings that ordinary decoration cannot.
strategic_value: Combining faces, gestures and illustrated reactions can make Twitch expression feel rooted in its community.
demonstration: Eight labeled emote cards form two rows, alternating pale and black grounds with names such as Kappa, bleedPurple and CoolStoryBob.
practical_value: Compare photographic cutouts and illustrated emotes within one repeated display structure.

content_islands.name: Top row
content_islands.spec: Pair each of four emote names with its large image on alternating pale and black cards.

content_islands.name: Bottom row
content_islands.spec: Continue the card rhythm with flame, greeting, robot and pointing-face specimens.

reference_purposes.Expression: The board mixes photographic faces and illustrated reactions in a labeled eight-card set.
